summary: Learn to map security controls, approvals, and audit evidence into CI/CD pipelines. Explore the course and strengthen secure delivery practice.
lede: Regulated DevSecOps training helps platform, security, risk and assurance professionals build auditable security controls into CI/CD workflows. Participants practise mapping controls across source, build and release, assessing pipeline and software supply-chain risks, defining approval and segregation-of-duties paths, and maintaining traceable audit evidence for risk-based release decisions in cloud-native and legacy environments.
audienceIntro: This course suits technology and assurance professionals who design, secure, operate, or review software delivery in regulated and critical environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with software delivery or technology risk is expected. Prior experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, or security and audit controls will help; programming is not required to complete the course.
